title: Chapter 108 The Terrifying Yan Lingyun
content:
Chapter 108 The Terrifying Yan Lingyun

However, Lu Daosheng seemed not to hear it, and just drank one bottle after another silently.

Soon, the alcohol got to his head, and Lu Daosheng's face turned red.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue pursed her lips, turned around and left with a depressed look.

[Love is love, not afraid of not having been there before, hate is hate, I never thought that the places I have been to are familiar with the past appearance, I thought I forgot to miss it,,]

"System, can you turn off the music?!"

At this time, Lu Daosheng said hatefully.

[Ahem, host, I am just responding to the situation]

Lu Daosheng shook his head and continued to drink.

He was obviously extremely sad at this moment, as if he had just broken up.

His wife, who he had waited for so many years, came back and said such hurtful words.

He had some complaints in his heart. Under the stimulation of Yan Lingyun's words, Lu Daosheng had obviously lost his judgment. If he was a little more sober at this moment, he would definitely be able to think of many loopholes.

But at this time, Lu Daosheng was just drinking to drown his sorrows.

[Host, don't be discouraged]

Hearing the system's words, Lu Daosheng said with a sad face: "System, I feel like my life has no meaning."

[! ! !]

[Ahem, host, your wife must have lied to you]

[Along the way, you can see the traces she left behind. Her intention is very obvious. She intends to protect this place, no, to be precise, she is protecting you]

At this time, the system immediately pointed out some of the problems, fearing that Lu Daosheng would be upset.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's expression moved slightly.

At this time, the system continued:

[Host, your wife is not simple]

Lu Daosheng frowned and shook his head violently to make himself sober.

Associating the various things he had discovered before with the system's words, Lu Daosheng began to mutter to himself.

"She was afraid of certain existences, so she had to use this method to protect me and Lu Xue?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng's IQ suddenly came online and he directly told the truth.

"That means she is in a very dangerous situation now."

Otherwise, it wouldn't be like this.

Lu Daosheng discovered it when he saw Yan Lingyun.

She is still her, without any change.

So, something must have happened at that time, and he was still an ordinary traverser without any ability at that time. If he stayed with Yan Lingyun, it would definitely be very dangerous.

Yan Lingyun had no choice but to leave him and his daughter in that remote place.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng suddenly felt ashamed.

[Host, you are so smart, but you don't have to worry, your wife is not simple]

[Her background is not ordinary, but the real horror is her]

Hearing the system's evaluation, Lu Daosheng was a little shocked.

Although the system was respectful to him, he understood that the system was very against the sky, and the vision was naturally ridiculously high. Now, the system made a terrifying evaluation of his wife.

This is not a compliment from the system to himself.

"Myself? System, is my wife very powerful?"

[Host, if you fight with your wife at the same level, you will know]

"What do you mean?"

[She can beat you with one hand]

"What?!"

At this time, Lu Daosheng was a little confused.

Beat with one hand?

This is a bit outrageous. You should know that the realm that the system has improved for me is not a bit of water, and it is stronger than the general realm.

And now, the system actually said that my wife can beat me with one hand at the same realm.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng smiled.

Anyway, this is my wife, and now the most urgent thing is to go to her and make it clear.

With my current ability, I still need to be afraid of unknown enemies.

Even if the opponent is stronger, so what.

It is no exaggeration to say that he can kill gods and Buddhas now!

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng swept away the haze, soared into the sky, and left the deserted city.

......

At the border of Xuanling Star Region

Yan Lingyun's figure slowly emerged, and at this moment, her delicate face was covered with tears.

Turning to look in the direction of the deserted city, Yan Lingyun didn't know whether to cry or laugh.

She was happy that Lu Daosheng had become stronger now, very strong, and seemed a little mysterious, but in her opinion, it was still not enough.

Because she had seen more terrifying existences.

And she also knew how dangerous she would face in the future.

The risk of bringing the father and daughter with her was too great.

Her original idea was to wait until she had solved it alone, and then come back to find the father and daughter, and then she could spend the rest of her life in peace.

Now, although there was a little change, it was not a big problem.

She believed that she could solve it by herself.

She had this confidence.

And the sad thing was what she said to Lu Daosheng.

Although she was just forced to do it, it was very hurtful.

"Daosheng, forgive me. I will come back to find you after I have dealt with everything."

Yan Lingyun stared at the direction of the deserted city with a determined look and murmured.

At this moment, above the sky.

A slight tremor caught Yan Lingyun's attention.

Looking up, his eyes suddenly passed through the endless void and looked directly at the sky.

Seeing, a woman in plain clothes slowly emerged from it.

Seeing this scene, Yan Lingyun frowned, then her body trembled and disappeared directly on the spot.

On the other side.

"Is this the lower world?"

Gongsun Sheng slowly opened his eyes and looked around.

"It's really bad."

Gongsun Sheng shook her head. She didn't expect that she would come to such a place one day.

At this time, her realm had retreated to the peak of the mortal realm.

(True Self Realm Mortal Realm Transmutation Realm Fairy Realm Fairy King Realm Fairy Lord Realm Fairy Lord Realm Fairy Saint Realm Fairy Emperor Realm)

The mortal realm is the last step in the cultivation of becoming an immortal.

Once you get rid of the mortal world and break through the immortal gate, you will reach the top and become an immortal!

But whether the immortal is the end is another matter.

The peak of the mortal realm, such strength is enough to walk sideways in the lower world.

What's more, her realm has only dropped to the mortal realm.

The real strength is not as simple as the mortal realm.

Dinglingling!

Gongsun Mo took out a silver bell expressionlessly, and a crisp sound suddenly rang out with the wind.

After just a moment, Gongsun Mo determined the direction.

This trip to the lower world was only for revenge.

Gongsun Sheng turned and looked in the direction of the Xuanling Star Region, and immediately murderous intent surged.

"What are you looking at?"

At this time, a cold voice suddenly sounded.

Gongsun Mo's face changed, and she looked in the direction of the voice, only to see that a strange woman had come to her side not far away.

Realizing that the other party's cultivation was only the True Self Realm, Gongsun Mo's face was a little ugly.

He was actually scared by such an ant.

"Get out, otherwise, die!"

Looking at Yan Lingyun, Gongsun Mo said coldly.

However, Yan Lingyun was indifferent, but there was a little more murderous intent in her eyes when she looked at Gongsun Mo.

"You are from the Holy Land of Immortals, right?"

"Hmm?"

Gongsun Mo was startled, and her eyes changed when she looked at Yan Lingyun.

"Who are you?"

She could actually tell the name of the power behind her. There was no way she was from the lower world.

Could it be that she, like herself, had used some extremely precious treasures to come to the lower world?

At this moment, Gongsun Mo's face suddenly changed.

Because an attack full of extreme power had already arrived in front of her.

With a loud bang.

The entire void collapsed directly.

A figure suddenly retreated thousands of feet away.
